canonical_county_target.county_fips: STATE ANSI zfill(2) + COUNTY ANSI zfill(3)

history_reference.fallback_1: same-state Huber trend using only county observations before t
history_reference.fallback_2: six-state pooled Huber trend using only observations before t

outer_design.inner_tuning: single latest development calendar year as validation; all earlier development years as training; no county random split
outer_design.learner_common_support: primary crop support + numeric target + A1 available for development and all four paired test systems

support.A1_available: at least one eligible MOD09 composite with positive valid support

optical_features.monthly: mean for Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug

lightgbm.inner_score: mean q10/q50/q90 pinball loss on single latest development year
lightgbm.selection: one parameter combination minimizing average three-quantile validation loss; deterministic grid-order tie break; refit all three quantiles on entire development pool
lightgbm.quantile_crossing: retain raw predictions; report crossing, no outcome-dependent post-processing

elasticnet.inner_score: MAE on single latest development calendar year
elasticnet.selection: one parameter combination minimizing validation MAE; deterministic grid-order tie break
elasticnet.heterogeneity_collapse_rule: complete collapse if paired A0/A1 ElasticNet median-loss benefits have no positive and no negative values across all evaluated rows

TV5_SOYBEAN_ANALYSIS_FREEZE.json.source_temporal_partner_rule: cyclic successor in lexicographically sorted frozen development states
TV5_SOYBEAN_ANALYSIS_FREEZE.json.source_training_year_rule: all legal source rows in 2012..t-1; source meta labels 2016..t-1
TV5_SOYBEAN_ANALYSIS_FREEZE.json.nested_upper_validation: latest two years t-2,t-1, each source state held out; meta training years 2016..v-1

source_base.source_grid: same fixed C1L LightGBM quantile grid; latest prior year inner selection
source_base.reference: same-county Huber, same-state then six-development-state fallback, only years < target

upper.sample_weight: QA1 corrected global equal state-year block mass after concat/label filtering; mean 1

questions.RQ1: SOURCE_DOMAIN_TEMPORAL Z2 vs ALWAYS_A1, represented geography/future year
questions.RQ2: UNSEEN_GEOGRAPHY Z2 vs ALWAYS_A1, paired transport gap against RQ1
questions.RQ3: Frozen external ERS regions Z2 vs A1 and AS, no policy reselection
questions.RQ4: UNSEEN_GEOGRAPHY Z2-Z1 on identical keys and source predictions

outcomes.primary: mean pinball q10/q50/q90, equal state-year or ERS-region-year blocks
outcomes.sign_agreement: exclude true zero-delta ties; compare always-A1-sign
outcomes.calibration: weighted linear slope true delta on score, equal block mass

aggregation.two_way_resampling: whole state/region and year clusters, 2000 repeats, seed 20260920, descriptive

TV5_SOYBEAN_ANALYSIS_FREEZE.json.interpretation_rule: Frozen in tv5_analysis.py; mixed remains S-E; no geography causal claim

TV1_RESEARCH_DESIGN_LOCK.json.issue_cutoff: August 31 inclusive; composite_end must be <= cutoff
TV1_RESEARCH_DESIGN_LOCK.json.main_loss: mean pinball at quantiles 0.1,0.5,0.9 in Mg/ha, then equal state-year blocks
five_risk_objects: R_Pi=inf_{p in finite Pi} E L_p
TV1_RESEARCH_DESIGN_LOCK.json.theory_limit: Fixed action pair/common Z required for source-target bound; target Bayes value not identified by same-evaluation plug-in

geometry.G0: source states S=all\{outer_s}; base training S, year<label_year; predict a source state
geometry.G1: base training S\{label_state}, year<label_year; predict excluded label_state
geometry.router_validation: for v,u: U=S\{v}; all meta training generated solely from U, year<u; G1 additionally excludes each r; validation pair trained U, year<u
geometry.validation_tasks: latest two eligible years <outer_t, all feasible source states; no random fallback

router_grid.selection: equal-state-year selected-action PB3; deterministic grid order then tree count

TV1_RESEARCH_DESIGN_LOCK.json.weighted_classifier_weight: block_weight * abs(delta); delta=0 weight 0; one-class fallback constant action

information_ladder.Z0: A0 quantiles/width + registered weather + prior crop support + quality
information_ladder.Z2: Z1 + A1-A0 quantile disagreement/width difference/crossing flags
information_ladder.Z3: Z2 + past-source-fit weather-conditional optical Ridge residuals + predefined physical month differences

TV1_RESEARCH_DESIGN_LOCK.json.information_caveat: Deterministic transforms of existing inputs need not add raw information; cannot call them new sensor evidence

statistics.bootstrap: two-way pigeonhole 10000 seed 20260913 descriptive for frozen predictions
statistics.dependence: state/year crossing; no county-year IID bootstrap

TV2_PRE_RESULT_SELECTION_FREEZE.json.scope: 36 already-seen development state-year blocks, 2019-2024; external confirmation excluded
TV2_PRE_RESULT_SELECTION_FREEZE.json.selection_loss: equal-state-year PB3 over all 36 registered blocks; lower is better
TV2_PRE_RESULT_SELECTION_FREEZE.json.practical_tie_rule: A candidate ties if (PB3_candidate - PB3_best) / PB3_best <= 0.005. PB3_best must be positive; if exactly zero, only exact-zero candidates tie.
TV2_PRE_RESULT_SELECTION_FREEZE.json.tie_order_rationale: L2 aligns to mean PB3 decision loss; G1 matches unseen-state future-year deployment geometry; R1 avoids fold-specific PCA coordinate semantics; routing order first favors simple candidates within 0.5%.
TV2_PRE_RESULT_SELECTION_FREEZE.json.future_confirmation_duplicate_policy_han: Deduplicate identical policy artifacts but retain both selected-policy role labels.
TV2_PRE_RESULT_SELECTION_FREEZE.json.final_strategy_freeze_prerequisite: Exact confirmation keys must already be frozen; do not create FINAL_STRATEGY_FREEZE.json before that gate.

02_TARGET_GRID_AUTHORITY.json.authority: Read-only A2 representative code and live Earth Engine projection/image queries on 2026-09-12
02_TARGET_GRID_AUTHORITY.json.local_crs_validation: At lon=-97, lat=31, local PROJ4 and ee.Projection('SR-ORG:6974') both returned x=-9245337.96776304, y=3447046.611276222. Direct GDAL parse of EE WKT uses WGS84 ellipsoid and incorrectly differs by about 18 km; do not use that parsed CRS for local warps.

crop_support.a2_prior_probability: mean of each yearly eq(1) image, masked by valid_count.eq(3), setDefaultProjection to first CDL cropland projection
crop_support.a2_target_weight: prior_probability.reduceResolution(ee.Reducer.mean(),maxPixels=1024 for MOD09 or 65535 for MOD11).reproject(exact target CRS and transform) * ee.Image.pixelArea().reproject(exact target CRS and transform)
crop_support.county_reducer: ee.Reducer.sum with crs and crsTransform, fractional region intersection approximately quantized to 8-bit 0..255

MOD09A1.qa: QA bits 0-1 == 0; for each of 7 bands its 4-bit quality field beginning at bit 2+4*i == 0; StateQA bits 0-1 == 0, bit 2 == 0, bits 3-5 == 1, bits 6-7 <=2, bits 8-9 <=1, bits 10,11,12,13,15 == 0
MOD09A1.product_valid: minimum mask across all 11 prepared output bands

MOD11A2.qc: For each QC: bits 0-1 <=1, bits 2-3 ==0, bits 4-5 <=1, bits 6-7 <=1; day and night must both pass
MOD11A2.product_valid: paired QC and minimum mask across day and night output bands
